name: Plaquemax
tagline: Maps the roadside historical markers on your route, with a heads-up before each
description: Tell it where you are driving and it arranges the historical markers on that route in the order you will pass them. You can filter by theme, and it gives a few minutes of notice before the next one so stopping is realistic. Markers can be read aloud while you keep your hands on the wheel.
author: ChrisAdcockMD
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
